title: Airodrom Limits & Blockers Registry
description: Source-grounded registry of operational limits, execution blockers, authorization gates, and recovery procedures. Live diagnostics combine these definitions with authoritative host state. Error messages never authorize recovery.

categories.operational_auto: Operational — automatically recoverable when an existing host-authorized operation and required evidence are present.
categories.operational_owner: Operational — owner action required; Airodrom must not invent grants, enrollments, or spend.
categories.security_critical: Security-critical — always fail closed; never auto-recover from the message alone.

discovery.note: Unknown runtime codes resolve as unknown_blocker rather than inventing classifications.

entries.description: Concurrent Developer Autonomy worktree slots are full for the policy.

automatic_recovery.note: Accounting no longer charges idle grantless ready; reclaim only cleans disposable leftovers.

entries.missing_prerequisite: An execution slot within the same policy max_worktrees budget, after proof-gated idle cleanup or settlement.

codes: Insufficient filesystem free space for Developer Autonomy
entries.description: Volume free space after reserve is insufficient for workspace preparation. Not a legacy max_disk_mb aggregate.
Historical aggregate max_disk_mb admission ceiling. Removed as an admission gate in PR #214; max_disk_mb remains signed-record compatibility only.
entries.failure_condition: legacy; no longer enforced as aggregate clone ceiling

entries.description: Active Missions under the DA policy exceed max_concurrent_missions.
Allowed file list violates DA file rules or exceeds max_files.
Repair attempts exceed policy repair budget.
entries.failure_condition: repair attempts >= budgets.max_repairs or requested repair_budget exceeds policy

entries.description: Requested repository is not enrolled under an active Developer Autonomy / cognitive policy.
entries.missing_prerequisite: An active enrollment for the exact source repository; an alias alone cannot enroll it.

entries.description: Arecibo Core repository is not enrolled for the requested work.
Instruction matches multiple enrolled repositories; host will not guess.
Projectless or unbound request requires an enrolled workspace binding.
Host refused borrowing another project fixture/grant when capacity or enrollment failed.
Paid or subscription Cursor execution lacks a current scoped owner spend authorization.
entries.missing_prerequisite: A current scoped subscription/spend authorization matching the worker, repository, files and remaining budget.

entries.description: External disclosure / subscription disclosure has not been acknowledged for this Cursor path.
entries.missing_prerequisite: Existing authorization for the exact external provider and disclosed data classes.

entries.description: No standing Cursor development grant covers this request.
Standing Cursor grant does not match the Developer Autonomy policy identity.
Standing Cursor grant path/repository binding does not match the requested workspace.
Standing Cursor grant data class does not cover the Mission data class.
Standing Cursor grant TTL expired.
Standing Cursor grant was revoked.
Standing Cursor grant invocation/runtime budget is exhausted.
Standing Cursor grant invocation count would be exceeded.
Standing Cursor grant runtime budget would be exceeded.
Standing Cursor grant failed generic match after specific mismatch checks.

recovery_dispatcher.note: Generic standing grant mismatch never auto-matches into authority.

entries.description: Host policy has Cursor execution disabled.
MCP caller lacks current host execution delegation for this action.
Work instruction contained secret-shaped material; refused.
Planner file set is empty or does not normalize into authorized files.

automatic_recovery.note: PR #216/#217 fixed normalization; retries stay within planning attempts.

entries.description: Instruction requires explicit worker syntax the planner did not receive.
entries.missing_prerequisite: An unambiguous eligible worker selection in the bounded request.

entries.description: Multiple workers could apply; host requires an explicit choice.
Caller is not on the enrolled cognitive delegated_callers list.
Cognitive caller delegation expired or was revoked.
Plan referenced a path outside sealed cognitive authorization.
Requested subscription invocation/runtime exceeds sealed envelope limits.
Planner exceeded max_assignments for the cognitive enrollment.
Sealed cognitive request envelope expired before dispatch.
request_id reuse with changed instruction/payload is denied.
Preferred external worker is not qualified for governed execution on this Mission.

recovery_dispatcher.note: Never-started READY specialists: refresh Cursor readiness and queue first assignment. Post-Cursor evaluation still reuses local evaluation authority when a completed worker run exists.

entries.description: A sealed specialist or cognitive plan named a worker that is not eligible under the Mission envelope, or a worker id that Airodrom does not qualify. Safe suffixes such as :cursor are normalized to this registry id. Distinct from transient Cursor runtime unreadiness and from Mission spend/disclosure authority.

recovery_dispatcher.note: Re-evaluate authoritative Cursor dimensions with a fresh readiness probe. If only runtime unreadiness remains and Mission authority is intact, requeue the existing dispatch. Never enroll, approve, or invent spend. Planning-only ineligible workers stay owner-gated.

entries.missing_prerequisite: Current host-observed qualification for the selected worker and a matching execution contract.

entries.description: Cursor is Mission-authorized but the governed runtime probe is not currently ready. Distinct from missing grants or cognitive worker ineligibility.

recovery_dispatcher.note: Fresh readiness + requeue existing dispatch when Mission grant/disclosure remain valid. Never launch a duplicate Cursor run.

entries.description: OpenCode evaluation could not complete; host reconciles then retries the verified worker packet without Cursor redispatch.
entries.missing_prerequisite: An available qualified evaluator, current authority and a valid verified packet within remaining evaluation budget.

entries.description: OpenCode or local provider readiness failed at evaluation admission (transient or not ready).
entries.missing_prerequisite: An available supported OpenCode runtime; retry only within the existing authority and evaluation budget.

entries.description: OpenCode executable/version/pins are unsupported for evaluation.
OpenCode evaluator exceeded its host timeout or Mission evaluation deadline.
OpenCode evaluator was cancelled (often by a raced recovery abort).
Evaluator process started but termination was not verified; fail closed until host process evidence reconciles.
Mission authority no longer permits local OpenCode evaluation.
Evaluator returned invalid or unbound structured evaluation JSON.
entries.missing_prerequisite: A schema-valid, stage-correct evaluation of the unchanged verified worker packet.

entries.description: OpenCode evaluation exceeded deadline.
Specialist assignment budget exhausted for the sealed graph.
A quarantined writer lease remains unreconciliation; fail closed.
Independent host verification failed.
Writer process still present; capacity/settlement cannot release safely.

recovery_dispatcher.note: Alive writers never auto-release quarantined leases.

entries.description: Worker termination was not independently verified.
entries.missing_prerequisite: Independent host proof that every recorded writer/process has terminated, followed by lease settlement.

entries.description: Bridge restart refused during cooldown.
Requested runtime has been removed from the product.
Idempotent request_id conflicts with a different payload.
Repair path is blocked by policy, budget, or unresolved evidence.
Terminal state requires an authenticated owner decision.
Host CONNECT proxy denied a DNS answer because it was empty of public addresses (private/rebinding). Distinct from abort and resolver errors.
Proxy CONNECT aborted because the subscription/grant signal fired. Historically mislabeled as dns_boundary.
Cursor worker cancelled because the reserved subscription deadline elapsed before the assignment finished.
CONNECT target hostname is not on the known Cursor provider allowlist.
System resolver failed or returned no answers for an authorized provider host.
The explicit request does not match enrolled, proposed, dispatched, or observed file operations.
entries.missing_prerequisite: The original exact operation/path bindings retained in the proposal, execution and independent host verification.

entries.description: Repository registration input is malformed or exceeds the bounded registry; legacy text alone cannot distinguish these causes.
entries.failure_condition: Repository input has invalid shape, path values or more than the allowed number of bindings; legacy text does not distinguish them.
entries.missing_prerequisite: Array required, at most MAX_PROJECT_REPOSITORIES entries, each a valid screened path.

entries.description: Project repository bindings have no free slot after safe retirement of terminal disposable aliases.
entries.failure_condition: The retained repository array has reached the 24-path ceiling before a new workspace can be registered.
entries.missing_prerequisite: Fewer than 24 retained project repository bindings before allocating a new workspace.

entries.description: More than one active enrolled repository matches the request.
entries.failure_condition: More than one active enrolled repository matches the request.
entries.missing_prerequisite: One exact enrolled repository or policy alias.

entries.description: A projectless request has no registered bounded workspace or verification scope.
entries.failure_condition: No registered bounded projectless scope and verification contract is available.
entries.missing_prerequisite: Registered projectless scope and measurable verification contract.

codes: Path is outside every read scope
Path is outside every write scope
Symbolic link resolves outside every read scope
Symbolic link resolves outside every write scope
entries.description: Lexical or canonical file target falls outside the required read/write scope.
entries.failure_condition: The lexical or canonical target is outside the required existing read/write scope.
entries.missing_prerequisite: Both lexical and real target must be in existing authorized scopes.

entries.description: The request needs an explicit literal file operation; no file or privilege is inferred.
entries.failure_condition: A literal requested file has no unambiguous explicit operation.
entries.missing_prerequisite: An explicit read/edit/create operation for every requested literal path.

entries.description: An evaluation applied edit completion criteria to a host-verified read assignment; never promote the blocked receipt.
entries.failure_condition: The evaluation uses completion criteria that conflict with the host-verified assignment stage.

automatic_recovery.note: No Cursor redispatch and no automatic acceptance from this diagnosis.

entries.missing_prerequisite: A stage-correct valid evaluation bound to the same verified worker packet and current authority.
